mentions.name: 2:1 live philosophy tutor
mentions.description: A philosophy tutor that runs 2:1 live philosophy lessons, each exploring a single topic, aimed at kids around 10 years old; currently in private testing, with a successful trial and improvements underway.
mentions.source_excerpt: a philosophy tutor (testing in private for now) that does 2:1 live philosophy lessons, each exploring a single topic (aimed at ~10yo kids). I've tested this successfully (i.e. two kids did an hour and they want to do it again), and am trying to make improvements.
mentions.author: rahimnathwani
